Change only two things.
1. The white handset in the cosmetologist's hand and its position are exactly as in the second reference image: the same wide curved white body lying almost flat along the top of the patient's head, its head end with the black oval Mitoscan panel resting on the parting, the panel facing up, the cable leaving the opposite end near her wrist. N.what: the look with the naked eye: both hands part the hair, no device
N.prompt: Reproduce the first reference image exactly - the same two women with the same faces, hair and clothes, the same brown headband, the same room, window, plant, light and framing. Change only this: there is no handset and no cable anywhere in the frame - the cosmetologist's hands are empty. With the gloved fingertips of both hands she gently parts the patient's hair along the parting and looks closely at the scalp with the naked eye, leaning a little closer. The patient sits calm, looking down as before. No device, no instrument, no screen in the frame. Nothing else changes. Photorealistic. No text, no captions.

E.what: the end of the visit: both smile, no device
E.prompt: Reproduce the first reference image exactly - the same two women with the same faces, hair and clothes, the same brown headband, the same room, window, plant, light and framing. Change only this: the examination is finished. There is no handset and no cable anywhere in the frame. The cosmetologist stands in the same place beside the patient, her gloved hands lowered and relaxed, one hand resting lightly on the back of the chair; she looks at the patient with a warm calm smile, explaining. The patient has raised her head and looks up at the cosmetologist with a calm content smile. No device, no instrument, no screen in the frame. Nothing else changes. Photorealistic. No text, no captions.

C1.from_to: N (one start frame, no end frame)
C1.prompt: One continuous shot, no cuts; the camera stays in place with only a barely noticeable drift. The cosmetologist in the white uniform and white gloves examines the patient's scalp with the naked eye: with the gloved fingertips of both hands she gently parts the hair along the parting, moves a little further along it, leans closer and looks carefully; the patient sits calm, looking down, and breathes quietly. Natural small movements, soft daylight. No device, no instrument, no screen appears. No text, no captions.

C2.prompt: One continuous shot, no cuts. For the first second the cosmetologist slowly glides the white handset a little along the parting; the handset stays as it is - lying almost flat on the top of the head, the black oval panel facing up, the cable at her wrist - and does not change its shape. Then the camera moves smoothly back and to the left and comes down to table height, so that the screen of the diagnostic system enters the frame in the left foreground, showing the magnified image of the scalp, with the silver base under it; the two women stay in the frame behind it and the cosmetologist keeps the handset on the parting. One continuous camera move with no jump. No text, no captions.

C3.from_to: S (one start frame, no end frame)
C3.prompt: One continuous shot, no cuts; the camera stays in place with only a barely noticeable drift. The cosmetologist keeps the white handset on the parting with one hand and moves it very slightly; on the screen in the left foreground the magnified image of the scalp shifts a little as the handset moves. The patient raises her eyes and looks at the screen with interest; the cosmetologist glances at the screen too and nods slightly, explaining. The handset, the screen and its base do not change their shape. Natural small movements, soft daylight. No text, no captions.
